title: Detailed toy block
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Block body: isometric cube in bright red -->
  <!-- Top face -->
  <polygon points='50,14 82,30 50,46 18,30' fill='#ff8a7a'/>
  <!-- Left face -->
  <polygon points='18,30 50,46 50,82 18,66' fill='#e03b2f'/>
  <!-- Right face -->
  <polygon points='82,30 50,46 50,82 82,66' fill='#ff5a4a'/>
  <!-- Top studs (three visible) -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='26' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#ffb3a8' stroke='#ff8a7a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <rect x='28' y='22' width='14' height='4' fill='#ff9d8f'/>
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='22' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#ffd0c8' stroke='#ffb3a8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='30' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#ffb3a8' stroke='#ff8a7a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <rect x='48' y='26' width='14' height='4' fill='#ff9d8f'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='26' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#ffd0c8' stroke='#ffb3a8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='18' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#ffb3a8' stroke='#ff8a7a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <rect x='43' y='14' width='14' height='4' fill='#ff9d8f'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='14' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#ffd0c8' stroke='#ffb3a8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Left face letter A (bright yellow) -->
  <g fill='#ffe14d'>
    <polygon points='27,58 33,58 38,72 35,72 34,68 26,68 25,72 22,72'/>
  </g>
  <polygon points='30,61 32,65 28,65' fill='#e03b2f'/>
  <!-- Right face small square decoration (light blue) -->
  <polygon points='62,54 72,59 72,70 62,65' fill='#7ad4ff'/>
  <polygon points='65,58 69,60 69,65 65,63' fill='#2f8fd0'/>
  <!-- Highlight edges -->
  <polyline points='18,30 50,46 82,30' fill='none' stroke='#ffd0c8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='46' x2='50' y2='82' stroke='#ff8a7a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='18' y1='30' x2='18' y2='66' stroke='#ff8a7a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='82' y1='30' x2='82' y2='66' stroke='#ffc0b8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
</svg>
